text: わざの　タイプと　ポケモンの　タイプの　あいしょうにより　こうかが　かわります　◎のタイプは…「こうかが　ばつぐん！」
note: The ◎ (double circle) is part of Japan's everyday rating marks: ◎ excellent, ○ good, △ so-so, × bad. A Japanese reader takes ◎ as "best" without being told.
claim: In Japan the symbols ◎, ○, △ and × are conventionally used as rating marks meaning excellent, good, mediocre and bad.

check.quote: A bullseye '◎' (nijūmaru; 二重丸) is often used for 'excellent', the circle is a plain affirmation, the triangle '△' (sankaku; 三角) means 'so-so' or 'partially applicable', and the '×' expresses disagreement.
